title: VisDocAgentBench: Benchmarking Agents for Visually Rich Document Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2608.17889v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Visually rich documents encode relevance through language, layout, structured visual elements, and corpus context, yet retrieval is typically evaluated by one-shot query--page matching. Agentic-search benchmarks usually score downstream question answering or report generation, leaving document ranking under iterative evidence acquisition underexplored. We introduce VisDocAgentBench, a closed-corpus benchmark comparing static and agentic retrieval under a shared ranked-output contract. It contains 2,375 pages from 100 documents and 120 unique-target queries balanced across direct, one-bridge, and two-bridge evidence structures. Relation-preserving construction yields semantic, relational, and visual queries, followed by full-document review and hard-negative validation. translated_title: VisDocAgentBench：面向视觉丰富文档检索的智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 视觉丰富的文档通过语言、布局、结构化视觉元素和语料库上下文来编码相关性，然而检索通常通过一次性查询-页面匹配来评估。智能体搜索基准通常评分下游问答或报告生成，留下在迭代证据获取下的文档排序未充分探索。我们引入了VisDocAgentBench，一个封闭语料库基准，在共享的排序输出契约下比较静态和智能体检索。它包含来自100份文档的2,375页和120个唯一目标查询，这些查询在直接、一跳桥接和两跳桥接证据结构上平衡。保持关系的构建产生语义、关系和视觉查询，随后进行全文审查和硬负样本验证。一个强大的晚期交互视觉检索器在直接项目上达到97.50%的Recall@1，但在两跳桥接项目上仅为2.50%，这暴露了当相关性需要多步推理时查询-目标匹配的局限性。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个封闭语料库基准，通过共享排序契约比较静态与智能体检索，揭示了传统查询匹配在需要多步证据获取的视觉丰富文档检索中的严重局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a closed-corpus benchmark comparing static and agentic retrieval under a shared ranked-output contract, revealing severe limitations of query-target matching in visually rich document retrieval requiring multi-step evidence acquisition.
